notes: Seven ranks, ordered low to high. Ground-form wyrm-kin (Siegewyrm, Ridgeback Runner) climb from the Wyrmkin tier on; most Dragon Host units already fly and ignore terrain cost, so climber only changes anything for the ground-bound ranks. Climber is the Dragon Host's signature movement trait, matching its mountain-and-cliff territory.

ranks.title: Hatchling
ranks.description: Newly-hatched, flies but cannot yet hold a line.

ranks.title: Wingling
ranks.description: Line drake of the Dragon Host.

ranks.title: Wyrmkin
ranks.description: Ground-bound kin bred for the cliffs: siege wyrms and ridge runners. Scales a mountainside like level ground.

ranks.title: Wing Adept
ranks.description: Blooded flier, faster on the wing and steadier over rough ground.

ranks.title: Wingsecond
ranks.description: Second of the flight, ready to take the Dominant's place.

ranks.title: Wing Dominant
ranks.description: Leader of the flight and its territory.

ranks.title: Elder
ranks.description: Eldest of the Hollow Crown, territorial dominance made flesh.

privilegeRules.climber: Mountain costs 3 Movement instead of 5 for Foot or 6 for Cavalry; no change for flying (already 2).
privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for auras and morale recovery, including Predatory Airspace.
privilegeRules.supreme: Reserved for campaign scale; not used in the vertical slice.
